what: selected PG-pre checkpoints on the val states of their pools; no test or calib state

notes.val_loss, terms: as the fit's validation computes them: per batch of EVAL_BATCH states a mean with the near-limit weights, the batches then averaged by their number of converged states; the four terms add up to val_loss up to FP32 rounding
notes.plain_mean: one mean over the converged val states of the network, loss weights applied, no near-limit weight
notes.correction_rms_pu: root mean square over converged val states, buses and conductors of the complex correction to the U1 prior, in pu of the nominal phase-to-neutral voltage, unweighted
